definitions.explanation: A detailed document that describes the technical requirements, features, and standards for a product, system, or project. Used extensively in IT, manufacturing, and construction.

examples.japanese: {仕様書|しようしょ}に{基|もと}づいて{開発|かいはつ}を{進|すす}める。
examples.english: Proceed with development based on the specifications.

examples.japanese: {仕様書|しようしょ}の{変更|へんこう}があった{場合|ばあい}はご{連絡|れんらく}ください。
examples.english: Please contact us if there are any changes to the specifications.

examples.japanese: {仕様書|しようしょ}どおりに{製品|せいひん}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: Make the product according to the specifications.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{仕様|しよう} (specifications, method) + {書|しょ} (document)

TYPES OF {仕様書|しようしょ}:
- {機能|きのう}{仕様書|しようしょ} - functional specifications
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}{仕様書|しようしょ} - technical specifications
- {設計|せっけい}{仕様書|しようしょ} - design specifications
- {要件|ようけん}{仕様書|しようしょ} - requirements specifications

COMMON IN:
- IT/ソフトウェア{開発|かいはつ} - software development
- {製造業|せいぞうぎょう} - manufacturing
- {建設業|けんせつぎょう} - construction
- {製品|せいひん}{開発|かいはつ} - product development

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {仕様書|しようしょ}を{作成|さくせい}する - to create specifications
- {仕様書|しようしょ}を{確認|かくにん}する - to review specifications
- {仕様|しよう}{変更|へんこう} - specification change
- {仕様書|しようしょ}どおり - according to specifications

RELATED WORDS:
- スペック (spec) - casual/abbreviated form
- {要件定義書|ようけんていぎしょ} - requirements document
